title: Status of leasehold time share interest as real property.
bodyText: Nothing in this part shall affect the status of a leasehold time share interest as real property.
bodyHtml: [§501-242]  Status of leasehold time share interest as real property.  Nothing in this part shall affect the status of a leasehold time share interest as real property. [L 1998, c 219, pt of §1]
